defmodule TenantCache do
  @moduledoc """
  Distributed cache client with multi-tenant isolation.
  Uses consistent hashing for node selection and tenant-scoped namespacing.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @hash_ring_size 1024
  @default_ttl 300_000

  defstruct [:tenant_id, :node_ring, :connections, :namespace_salt]

  # Public API

  def start_link(opts) do
    tenant_id = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :tenant_id)
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: via_tuple(tenant_id))
  end

  def get(tenant_id, key) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(tenant_id), {:get, key})
  end

  def put(tenant_id, key, value, ttl \\ @default_ttl) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(tenant_id), {:put, key, value, ttl})
  end

  def delete(tenant_id, key) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(tenant_id), {:delete, key})
  end

  def invalidate_pattern(tenant_id, pattern) do
    GenServer.call(via_tuple(tenant_id), {:invalidate_pattern, pattern})
  end

  # GenServer callbacks

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    tenant_id = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :tenant_id)
    nodes = Keyword.get(opts, :nodes, ["127.0.0.1:6379"])
    salt = Keyword.get(opts, :namespace_salt, generate_salt())

    ring = build_hash_ring(nodes)
    connections = establish_connections(nodes)

    state = %__MODULE__{
      tenant_id: tenant_id,
      node_ring: ring,
      connections: connections,
      namespace_salt: salt
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:get, key}, _from, state) do
    scoped_key = scope_key(state, key)
    node = select_node(state.node_ring, scoped_key)
    result = execute_on_node(state.connections, node, [:get, scoped_key])
    {:reply, deserialize_value(result), state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:put, key, value, ttl}, _from, state) do
    scoped_key = scope_key(state, key)
    serialized = serialize_value(value)
    node = select_node(state.node_ring, scoped_key)
    result = execute_on_node(state.connections, node, [:setex, scoped_key, div(ttl, 1000), serialized])
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:delete, key}, _from, state) do
    scoped_key = scope_key(state, key)
    node = select_node(state.node_ring, scoped_key)
    result = execute_on_node(state.connections, node, [:del, scoped_key])
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:invalidate_pattern, pattern}, _from, state) do
    scoped_pattern = scope_pattern(state, pattern)
    results = broadcast_to_all_nodes(state, [:keys, scoped_pattern])
    keys_to_delete = List.flatten(results)
    # Verify each key belongs to this tenant's namespace before deletion
    namespace = compute_namespace(state.tenant_id, state.namespace_salt)
    verified_keys = Enum.filter(keys_to_delete, fn key ->
      String.starts_with?(to_string(key), namespace <> ":")
    end)
    deletion_results = Enum.map(verified_keys, fn key ->
      node = select_node(state.node_ring, key)
      execute_on_node(state.connections, node, [:del, key])
    end)
    {:reply, {:ok, length(deletion_results)}, state}
  end

  # Key scoping - ensures tenant isolation

  defp scope_key(state, key) do
    namespace = compute_namespace(state.tenant_id, state.namespace_salt)
    normalized = normalize_key(key)
    # Verify the normalized key doesn't escape the namespace
    if String.contains?(normalized, ":") do
      raise ArgumentError, "Key contains invalid characters after normalization"
    end
    "#{namespace}:#{normalized}"
  end

  defp scope_pattern(state, pattern) do
    namespace = compute_namespace(state.tenant_id, state.namespace_salt)
    normalized_pattern = normalize_pattern(pattern)
    "#{namespace}:#{normalized_pattern}"
  end

  defp compute_namespace(tenant_id, salt) do
    hash_input = "#{tenant_id}:#{salt}"
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, hash_input)
    |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    |> binary_part(0, 16)
  end

  defp normalize_key(key) when is_binary(key) do
    key
    |> String.replace(":", "_")
    |> String.replace("\n", "")
    |> String.replace("\r", "")
    |> String.replace("*", "")
    |> String.replace("?", "")
    |> String.replace("[", "")
    |> String.replace("]", "")
  end

  defp normalize_key(key), do: normalize_key(to_string(key))

  defp normalize_pattern(pattern) when is_binary(pattern) do
    # Only allow * as glob character, escape everything else
    pattern
    |> String.replace(":", "_")
    |> String.replace("\n", "")
    |> String.replace("\r", "")
    |> String.replace("?", "")
    |> String.replace("[", "")
    |> String.replace("]", "")
  end

  defp normalize_pattern(pattern), do: normalize_pattern(to_string(pattern))

  # Hash ring implementation

  defp build_hash_ring(nodes) do
    virtual_nodes_per_node = div(@hash_ring_size, length(nodes))
    
    nodes
    |> Enum.flat_map(fn node ->
      Enum.map(0..virtual_nodes_per_node, fn i ->
        hash = :erlang.phash2({node, i}, @hash_ring_size)
        {hash, node}
      end)
    end)
    |> Enum.sort_by(&elem(&1, 0))
  end

  defp select_node(ring, key) do
    hash = :erlang.phash2(key, @hash_ring_size)
    case Enum.find(ring, fn {pos, _node} -> pos >= hash end) do
      {_pos, node} -> node
      nil -> elem(List.first(ring), 1)
    end
  end

  # Connection management

  defp establish_connections(nodes) do
    Map.new(nodes, fn node ->
      [host, port] = String.split(node, ":")
      conn = %{host: host, port: String.to_integer(port), socket: nil}
      {node, conn}
    end)
  end

  defp execute_on_node(connections, node, command) do
    case Map.get(connections, node) do
      nil -> {:error, :no_connection}
      conn -> send_command(conn, command)
    end
  end

  defp broadcast_to_all_nodes(state, command) do
    Enum.map(state.connections, fn {node, _conn} ->
      execute_on_node(state.connections, node, command)
    end)
  end

  defp send_command(conn, command) do
    # Simulated Redis protocol interaction
    Logger.debug("Executing #{inspect(command)} on #{conn.host}:#{conn.port}")
    encode_resp_command(command)
    {:ok, nil}
  end

  defp encode_resp_command(parts) do
    parts_encoded = Enum.map(parts, fn part ->
      part_str = to_string(part)
      "$#{byte_size(part_str)}\r\n#{part_str}\r\n"
    end)
    "*#{length(parts)}\r\n#{Enum.join(parts_encoded)}"
  end

  # Serialization

  defp serialize_value(value) do
    :erlang.term_to_binary(value)
    |> Base.encode64()
  end

  defp deserialize_value({:ok, nil}), do: {:ok, nil}
  defp deserialize_value({:ok, data}) when is_binary(data) do
    case Base.decode64(data) do
      {:ok, binary} -> {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(binary, [:safe])}
      :error -> {:error, :invalid_data}
    end
  end
  defp deserialize_value(error), do: error

  # Utilities

  defp via_tuple(tenant_id) do
    {:via, Registry, {TenantCache.Registry, tenant_id}}
  end

  defp generate_salt do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode64()
  end
end

defmodule TenantCache.BatchOperations do
  @moduledoc """
  Batch operations that work across multiple keys for a tenant.
  Includes pipeline support for performance.
  """

  def multi_get(tenant_id, keys) when is_list(keys) do
    Enum.map(keys, fn key ->
      {key, TenantCache.get(tenant_id, key)}
    end)
  end

  def multi_put(tenant_id, key_value_pairs, ttl \\ 300_000) do
    Enum.map(key_value_pairs, fn {key, value} ->
      {key, TenantCache.put(tenant_id, key, value, ttl)}
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Copies a key from one tenant's cache to another.
  Used during tenant migration scenarios.
  Validates that the caller has admin privileges.
  """
  def copy_key(source_tenant, dest_tenant, key, admin_token) do
    with :ok <- verify_admin_token(admin_token),
         {:ok, value} <- TenantCache.get(source_tenant, key) do
      TenantCache.put(dest_tenant, key, value)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Warms the cache for a tenant by pre-loading frequently accessed keys.
  The loader_fn receives the raw key and returns the value to cache.
  """
  def warm_cache(tenant_id, keys, loader_fn) do
    keys
    |> Task.async_stream(fn key ->
      case TenantCache.get(tenant_id, key) do
        {:ok, nil} ->
          value = loader_fn.(key)
          TenantCache.put(tenant_id, key, value)
          {:loaded, key}
        {:ok, _existing} ->
          {:cached, key}
        error ->
          {:error, key, error}
      end
    end, max_concurrency: 10, timeout: 5_000)
    |> Enum.map(fn {:ok, result} -> result end)
  end

  # Verify the admin token against a configured secret using a
  # constant-time comparison to avoid trivial forgery and timing attacks.
  defp verify_admin_token(token) when is_binary(token) do
    expected = configured_admin_token()

    if is_binary(expected) and byte_size(expected) > 0 and
         secure_compare(token, expected) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end

  defp verify_admin_token(_), do: {:error, :unauthorized}

  defp configured_admin_token do
    Application.get_env(:tenant_cache, :admin_token) ||
      System.get_env("TENANT_CACHE_ADMIN_TOKEN")
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when is_binary(a) and is_binary(b) do
    byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) and :crypto.hash_equals(a, b)
  end

  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false
end
